question: The hydrotherapy treatment centre (water clinic) for elephants suffering from arthritis, joint pain and foot ailment is situated at:
solution:
The correct answer is** Mathura.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​​**

__
 
• Any technique that uses water to treat different bodily problems is** known as hydrotherapy.**
 
• Taking a warm bath at home can serve as a form of** hydrotherapy.**
 
• **Hydrotherapy is the practise** of using water to treat illnesses and relieve pain.
 
• It opens close to the** Elephant Conservation and Care Centre of Wildlife **SOS, which is home to 20 rescued elephants at the moment. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​​​**

 
• The new** hydrotherapy jumbo pool contains 21 high-pressure jet sprays **that provide water pressure that massages the elephants' feet and bodies while assisting in** boosting blood circulation**. It is 11 feet deep.
 
• The** Uttar Pradesh Forest Department and the NGO Wildlife **SOS collaborated to create the centre.
 
• With its inherent resistance**, hydrotherapy aids** in both the relief of chronic muscular aches and the rebuilding of muscle memory.
